mapper.sql: FROM CHAT_ROOM R JOIN CONTENT_MASTER CM ON CM.CONTENT_ID = R.CONTENT_ID WHERE CM.IS_DELETED = 'N'

R.ROOM_ID AS ID, R.CONTENT_ID, CM.USER_ID, R.TITLE, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CM.CREATED_AT) * 1000 AS CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CM.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 AS UPDATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID) AS MESSAGE_COUNT, (SELECT M.MESSAGE FROM CHAT M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.SENT_AT DESC, M.MESSAGE_ID DESC LIMIT 1) AS LAST_MESSAGE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM (ROOM_ID, CONTENT_ID, TITLE, USER_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{contentId}, #{title}, #{userId})
INSERT INTO CHAT (MESSAGE_ID, ROOM_ID, SENDER_TYPE, MESSAGE) VALUES (#{id}, #{roomId}, #{senderType}, #{message})
mapper.sql: MESSAGE_ID AS ID, ROOM_ID, SENDER_TYPE, MESSAGE, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(SENT_AT) * 1000 AS SIGNED) AS SENT_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM CHAT WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY SENT_AT, MESSAGE_ID

SELECT FROM CHAT C WHERE C.ROOM_ID IN ( SELECT R.ROOM_ID FROM CHAT_ROOM R JOIN CONTENT_MASTER CM ON CM.CONTENT_ID = R.CONTENT_ID WHERE CM.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND CM.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ) AND C.SENT_AT >= CONCAT(#{date}, ' 00:00:00') AND C.SENT_AT <= CONCAT(#{date}, ' 23:59:59.999') ORDER BY C.SENT_AT, C.MESSAGE_ID
